signals: Startup brief score regressed to 54.0% with creativity, proposals, and SIL gaps.
Task board points to interactive world-feed routing, Director-driven Daily Rite planning, Supabase hardening, and App.jsx extraction.
Current live backend gate is blocked on SUPABASE_DB_URL, while browser runtime must remain deterministic and zero-token by default.

items.title: Turn Director route segments into playable briefings
items.why: The Director already computes route segments, shrine chance, rival chance, and pressure, but the player-facing layer mostly shows raw pressure. Converting those mechanics into compact tactical route briefs makes the daily dungeon feel authored without paid generation.
items.recipe: Extend `src/game/directorMechanics.js` with deterministic segment goals, danger labels, reward tells, and route summary text; surface the summary through chronicle/feed data and tests.

items.title: Add deterministic outcome receipts for player/world actions
items.why: The startup brief reports 0/15 receipts/outcomes, and the current UI explains actions but does not produce a reusable receipt contract. A public-safe receipt layer lets Solara close the loop after runs, offerings, reactions, and world-feed clicks while feeding Studio integrations without new token cost.
items.recipe: Add a `src/game/outcomeReceipts.js` module, include receipt summaries in public chronicle integration data, and cover it with unit tests.

items.title: Repair blocker-preflight so human-blocker discipline works
items.why: `node scripts/blocker-preflight.mjs` currently fails because `scripts/lib/blocker-rules.mjs` is missing. That breaks CANON-019 evidence gathering and makes the Supabase DB URL blocker harder to classify cleanly.
items.recipe: Create the missing blocker rules helper with conservative classification for signup-only, credential, deploy, migration, and agent-attemptable tasks; rerun the preflight.

items.title: Expose backend readiness without leaking secrets
items.why: Solara has a clear live backend gap: read probes work, hardened RPCs are not deployed, and `SUPABASE_DB_URL` is missing. A deterministic readiness digest lets UI, public JSON, and handoff docs say exactly what is safe now without exposing or depending on secrets.
items.recipe: Add a public-safe backend readiness module that summarizes local/live/hardened modes, required non-secret next action labels, and player-facing copy; wire it into chronicle exports and tests.

items.title: Make world-feed clicks return structured action results
items.why: World feed items are clickable, but action handling is inline in `App.jsx` and only logs a terse console line. A structured action-result module makes every feed click produce a consistent route, tab, target, and receipt-ready summary.
items.recipe: Add an exported world-feed action resolver, use it in App.jsx, and test tab/map/setting outcomes.

items.title: Publish a zero-token runtime cost guardrail in public status
items.why: Solara already has a strong deterministic policy, but the status/chronicle contract should make the cost boundary impossible to miss. This protects the pre-revenue free-tier posture while allowing future server-side cached summaries to be gated deliberately.
items.recipe: Extend intelligence policy/status output with a runtime cost guardrail object and assertions that browser token cost remains 0.
